positive_snippets: SK Premium Park truly lives up to its name. The property is beautifully maintained, spacious, and thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect blend of comfort and elegance. The environment is clean, peaceful, and ideal for both families and professionals. Amenities are top-notch, and the overall ambiance feels safe and welcoming. The management is responsive and professional, ensuring everything runs smoothly. It’s a great place to live and invest—highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and value in one place!

Nice and good ambience. Good clean rooms to stay, nice place for all kinds of events, from basement to trace, rooms are good, dinning area is also good along with foods, breakfast, lunch, dinner. Hotel services are good too, but I think lift or elevator is somewhat, it should be upgraded for a better version. Rest all good. Thank you 🙏.

Have a long stay for a month here, great service especially from staff named Roshan always greets with a a smile and makes a happy morning and always gives great service no matter what day.
Jagmohan is another great chef always making a brilliant service with his food and manners, if you have a request he will fulfill it with beyond expectations
Another is room service named Aryan always polite happy too help and do extra work if needed always great with a good morning and a happy engery and positive vibes, great people all around will solve any issue that may happen.
Special thanks too their manager Amit for managing such a great team and going above and beyond no matter what we needed.
Will definitely return and stay here again.
negative_snippets:
My stay at SK Premium Park Hotel was extremely disappointing and honestly one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had.

First of all, the location is not good at all. The surrounding area does not feel pleasant or suitable for a hotel that claims to be a premium property.

The rooms are very old and poorly maintained. The floor tiles make loud noises whenever you walk. The washroom was in terrible condition — the toilet seat was leaking, and the washbasin tap was completely broken. The moment you turn it on, water spills all over the floor. Even the washbasin itself is loose and moves when you touch it.

As soon as you step out of the lift, there is a very bad smell throughout the floor, which is extremely unpleasant. Cleanliness is also very poor. When I entered the room and went to wash, I noticed the brushes kept in the washroom looked dirty, old, and already used.

The food was another big problem. The hotel kitchen seems to use very bad and smelly oil, and the food tasted unpleasant.

This hotel is shown as 4-star on Goibibo, while on Google it shows 3-star, but honestly it does not deserve even one star. The cleanliness, maintenance, and quality are far below basic hotel standards.

Because of the unhygienic conditions, I even fell sick during my stay. I would strongly advise people not to stay here.

Very disappointing experience. Definitely not recommended.

Rooms are 3 star. Comfortable bed. There is road noise in the front rooms of the hotel. Unfortunately the shower taps were dripping constantly. We stayed for 2 nights and our room, and our friends room, were not made up after the first night. Apparently we need to give permission to make up the room which we were not told prior.  Go figure.
